mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% signals monetary easing that lowers equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) and moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 310) creates stable monetary conditions that support equity valuations, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% and CPIAUCSL < 310 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 22000 and UNRATE < 4.0%), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) triggers negative equity returns due to reduced growth expectations over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when GDPC1 > 22000, UNRATE < 4.0%, and FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates tight labor market conditions that fuel wage growth and corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST > 1350) reflect strong consumer demand for construction, which precedes positive equity market returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when HOUST > 1350 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) and moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 310) indicates stable monetary policy that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% and CPIAUCSL < 310 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 103.5) indicates robust manufacturing activity that correlates with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO > 103.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
